plugin.title: b3l0w Net
plugin.description: Tailscale and Sunshine state: peers, DERP relay, ports, encoder and last session. Never stops or restarts a service.

refresh_seconds.label: Poll interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.desc: How often tailscale status, the Sunshine unit and the log are read.

show_label.label: Show the count in the bar

hide_when_offline.label: Hide when Tailscale is offline
hide_when_offline.desc: Hides the widget while the backend is not Running.

glyph.label: Bar icon
glyph.desc: Glyph used when everything is fine. Offline, failed and relayed peers use their own icons.

panel_mode.label: Panel style
panel_mode.desc: Compact attached panel or large floating one.

animations.label: Animations
animations.desc: Staggered card entry when switching tabs.

settings.settings.layout_mode.label: Layout
settings.settings.layout_mode.desc: Automatic: the host measures the panel and the content fits it. Fixed: the plugin asks for an explicit width.

ts.netcheck_tip: Runs tailscale netcheck (takes a few seconds) and shows UDP, IPv4/IPv6, DERP and port mapping.
ts.netcheck_idle: netcheck measures UDP, DERP and port mapping. It takes a few seconds.
ts.netcheck_hint: network diagnosis from this machine's side
ts.ping_tip: tailscale ping -c 3 with a 10 s timeout. This is the test that separates network from Moonlight.
ts.relay_banner_body: Traffic leaves through a Tailscale server instead of a direct path: latency climbs and the stream drops. Nothing here can fix that.
ts.pref_exit_tip: Use or stop using an exit node
ts.exit_none: No peers online to use as exit node

sun.no_touch: This plugin never stops, disables or restarts Sunshine. It only reads state.
sun.fix_tip: Runs systemctl --user reset-failed and then start. No stop, disable or restart.
sun.fix_hint: The unit is in failed (crash-loop). Starting it again requires clearing the failure state: reset-failed and start.
sun.fix_confirm_text: That command is about to run. It cannot cut a session: in failed there is none.
sun.encoder_ok: vaapi: no software or vulkan in the path
sun.encoder_bad: {value} showed up in the log. On this machine (Intel, no NVIDIA) nvenc fails on cuda and vulkan core-dumps: pin encoder = vaapi in sunshine.conf.
sun.session_none: No CLIENT CONNECTED in the log.
sun.config_ok: capture, output_name and ports match this machine.
sun.warn_capture: capture = {value}: Sunshine will not capture on wlroots. It has to be wlr.
sun.warn_output: output_name = {value} is not an existing output.
sun.warn_encoder: {value} in the log: that is the crash-loop cause on this machine. Use encoder = vaapi.
sun.warn_http: the web panel answered {value} (401 or 307 is healthy).
sun.warn_state: the unit is failed: use the button above.

error.ts_missing: The tailscale CLI is not installed.

service.reset_needs_failed: reset-failed + start only applies to a unit in failed.
